_comments: bizapps-sales#272: a deal's Internal team grid had no DefaultInView field, so MJ showed the first
ten fields: Deal ID, Employee ID, Person ID, Deal Role ID and the rest as GUIDs. The role, which
answers 'who owns this deal', was visible only as an id. The grid is member, role, attribution and
the dates the member was on the deal.
THE FLAG GOES ON THE VIRTUAL NAME FIELDS, NOT THE FOREIGN KEYS. Employee, Person and DealRole are
the names the base view already resolves; flagging EmployeeID, PersonID or DealRoleID would show
the GUIDs this file exists to remove.
Employee and Person are two columns because a team member is exactly one of them and there is no
single member-name field in the view. Each row fills one of the two.
IsActive and Notes are left off: EndDate already says whether a member is still on the deal, and
Notes is long text. Both stay available from the grid's column chooser.
